raw:
Sergio Pérez had two results of second or third in 2016, both third-place finishes:

- **Monaco Grand Prix (round 6):** 3rd
- **European Grand Prix, Baku (round 8):** 3rd

I checked all 21 rounds of the 2016 season. Pérez finished 4th at Brazil and 5th at Belgium, and was outside the top 10 at Australia, Bahrain, China, Austria and Hungary. The other results were all 6th or lower. None of the others were 2nd or 3rd.

ANSWER: 2
